note: Times are in beats (one beat = 60/128 s = 0.469 s, one bar = 4 beats). A shot plays clips/<id>.mp4 when that file exists, otherwise its still, otherwise a placeholder card. 'in' is where to start inside the clip, in seconds.

shots.record: Pine Valley, admin Waves -> Jump to wave 15. Low camera at knee height in front of your squad, horde running at the lens. TrailerCam: two keys, slow push toward the squad.

Same wave. Give yourself Tier IV Godly weapons in all 6 slots (admin Give weapon) and God mode; friends fight next to you. TrailerCam ORBIT on yourself, radius ~30. Your weapons keep firing while you film.
Close-up: Ray Gun Tier IV kills disintegrating in a burst. TrailerCam FOLLOW on yourself at distance ~12.
Close-up: Reaper's Scythe 360 reap raising wraiths. ORBIT radius ~15, fast (press ] twice).
Lobby: open the Armory (Weapons tab), click through 3 weapons, then CHANGE CLASS. Screen recording, UI on.
Between-wave shop: buy a weapon you already hold so two copies MERGE into Tier II, then reroll once. Admin: Waves, Shards Add 1000.
Level-up cards appear and you pick one. Admin: Level Add 3 during the shop.
Your avatar with 6 Godly/Legendary weapons floating around, slow ORBIT, mobs closing in (Keep 20 alive).
Chest screen: open a Legendary or Magical chest x1, tap until it bursts, hold on the item card. Best if it rolls a Godly weapon.
Egg screen: hatch x3, tap through the cracks to the pet reveal.
